analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range, MACD momentum weakening
analysis.reason: 최근 5일간 변동률 -3.14%로 하락 마감. RSI 51.7로 중립 구간 유지, MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 지속되나 강세 확산은 미약. 거래량 위축으로 방향성 부재. 스윙 저항 110,910원, 지지 103,800원 사이 횡보 구간 진입.
analysis.reasonEn: Closed down 3.14% over the last 5 days. RSI at 51.7 remains in neutral territory, and while the MACD histogram continues to improve, bullish expansion is weak. Low volume indicates a lack of directional conviction. The price is consolidating between the swing resistance at 110,910 KRW and support at 103,800 KRW.

· 52주 위치(59.2%) + 현 가격대 역사적 중간 수준
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (48.2→51.7) + 중립 판단 + 방향성 약보합
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-133.9538→431.2311) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 약함
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 108,403원) + 밴드폭 10.92% 수준

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 방향성 부재
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.51배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (109,590 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (111,120 KRW/108,403 KRW/105,964 KRW): below short-term, above mid-term
· Position vs SMA100/200 (116,400 KRW/96,459 KRW): below mid-to-long term
· 52-week position (59.2%) + current price level at historical midpoint
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.2→51.7) + neutral assessment + slightly bearish directionality
· MACD histogram trajectory (-133.9538→431.2311) + improvement diagnosis + weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 108,403 KRW) + band width at 10.92% level
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support (103,800 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (101,515 KRW)
· Swing resistance (110,910 KRW) + potential mid-term trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + lack of directional trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.51x) + low confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + confirmation of wait-and-see conditions
